description: This file manages WhatsApp account configurations, including listing, resolving authentication directories, checking credentials, and handling account details within a larger application.

methods.name: listWhatsAppAuthDirs
methods.description: Returns a list of authentication directories for configured WhatsApp accounts, including legacy and dynamically discovered directories.

methods.name: hasAnyWhatsAppAuth
methods.description: Checks if any valid WhatsApp credentials exist for the given configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAuthDir
methods.description: Resolves the default authentication directory for a given account ID.

methods.name: resolveLegacyAuthDir
methods.description: Resolves the legacy authentication directory used by older credentials.

methods.name: legacyAuthExists
methods.description: Checks if legacy credentials file exists in the specified directory.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppAuthDir
methods.description: Resolves the authentication directory for a specific WhatsApp account, considering legacy and configured directories.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppAccount
methods.description: Resolves full account details for a given account ID, including configuration and authentication info.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppMediaMaxBytes
methods.description: Calculates the maximum media size in bytes for a WhatsApp account based on its configuration.

methods.name: listEnabledWhatsAppAccounts
methods.description: Lists all enabled WhatsApp accounts based on current configuration.
